title: THE FURNACE · TABATA LAPS
vibe: 45 min · green · hard · 5 Tabata stations, 40 work intervals, a run leg out of every one
why: First Tabata in the log: 20 on / 10 off, eight intervals a station, score is your worst interval. Station 3 is a full four minutes of loaded midline, and legs are back under load after a run-only day.

blocks.title: WARM-UP · 6 MIN · ONE PASS
blocks.meta: Moves Method Day B — shoulders / ankles / knees

items.name: Toe squat ×10 · ankle rolls in a deep squat 30s/side

blocks.title: THE FURNACE · 5 STATIONS · 40 WORK INTERVALS
blocks.meta: 5 TABATAS · 20s ON / 10s OFF × 8 EACH · 352 REPS · 1.0 mi · 50 lb · 2×40 lb · 35 lb
blocks.format: One clock. Run a full Tabata at the station (8 intervals), then the run leg, then the next station. Score each station by your LOWEST interval.
blocks.workRest: 20s work / 10s rest × 8 = 4:00 per station. Run legs are 0.20 mi: 7.5 · 7.5 · 8.0 · 8.0 · 8.5.

items.name: S1 · Bear-hug squat 50 lb — hold 8/interval
items.detail: DB hugged to the chest, elbows in

items.name: S2 · Double high pull 2×40 — hold 8/interval
items.detail: elbows high and outside, bells to the ribs

items.name: S3 · CORE — alternate every interval: weighted V-up 35 lb ×8 / Russian twist 35 lb ×12
S4 · Curtsy step-behind 50 lb — hold 8/interval
items.detail: one DB at your side, back foot behind and past the standing leg

blocks.noteGreen: Log your lowest interval at each station, total time, RPE, and which Tabata broke first.
blocks.text: ★ BEAR-HUG SQUAT — squeeze the bell, don't let it slide. ★ HIGH PULL — hinge and snap, arms follow. ★ RUSSIAN TWIST — feet off the floor, rotate from the ribs. ★ CURTSY STEP-BEHIND — new movement, first two intervals are the calibration.

timer.emomUnit: work intervals held at the floor
